subject.title: [Feature Request] Multi-window session support - new window pauses existing sessions

question: Should macOS WebChat support multiple concurrent chat windows now, and what should own active-session focus when several windows are open?
rationale: The current source shows the missing behavior, but the fix changes native window ownership, `/new` semantics, active-session subscription/focus, and adjacent voice/approval routing, so automation should not choose the product contract alone.

options.title: Design multi-window WebChat now
options.body: Keep this issue open and have macOS/session owners define the keyed window-controller model, active-focus rules, and create-session transport behavior before implementation.

options.title: Defer to broader macOS window work
options.body: Keep this issue linked to broader macOS companion UI work if maintainers want floating bubbles or another window model to settle the session ownership contract first.

options.title: Keep single-window behavior
options.body: Close only after an explicit maintainer decision that macOS WebChat should remain a single-window/session-switcher surface and `/new` reset fallback is intentional.

recommendation.title: Design multi-window WebChat now
recommendation.body: Keep this issue open and have macOS/session owners define the keyed window-controller model, active-focus rules, and create-session transport behavior before implementation.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete has the strongest recent history on the macOS WebChat/window ownership path and adjacent macOS UI direction.
